Looking for a porta cabin in Coimbatore? SAMAN manufactures steel porta cabins and ships them ready-to-use to sites across Coimbatore from our Bangalore factory. The road distance is about 365 km, so a finished unit usually reaches your site in 3 to 5 days. You get a single-room steel cabin â€” site office, security post, rest room, or store â€” built to size, wired, and finished before it leaves the factory. No on-site construction, no waiting weeks for masonry to cure.

SAMAN has been making prefab steel structures since 2009 and runs two factories â€” Bangalore for South India and Greater Noida for the North. Coimbatore is served fully from Bangalore, which is why transit is short and freight stays low. If you want to see the full porta cabin range before deciding on a size, the spec sheets and photos are all there.

Why buyers in Coimbatore choose SAMAN

Coimbatore runs on industry. The textile mills, the foundries, the pump and motor units in Kurichi and Ganapathy, the IT offices on the Saravanampatti corridor â€” they all need quick, movable workspace that holds up to daily use. A porta cabin gives you that without tying up land or waiting on a building permit for a temporary structure.

We build to order, not from stock. That means your cabin is sized for your site, finished in the colour you want, and fitted with the electrical points and windows you actually need. As a manufacturer we control the steel, the panels, and the finish in-house, so what we quote is what we build. SAMAN holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certification, and has delivered 500+ projects across India. See the full range of porta cabin units we build to this standard.

Local industries in Coimbatore that use porta cabins

Coimbatore's industrial belt is spread across well-known zones, and each uses these cabins differently:

  • SIDCO Industrial Estate, Kurichi (641021) â€” foundries and engineering units use porta cabins as supervisor offices and tool stores on the shop floor.
  • Peelamedu and Ganapathy (641004) â€” pump, motor, and wet-grinder manufacturers use them as quality-check rooms and staff rest areas.
  • Saravanampatti IT corridor (641035) â€” IT parks and developers along the corridor use them as site offices and security cabins during fit-outs.
  • Arasur and the NH-544 belt â€” construction firms working the Salemâ€“Kochi highway projects use them as on-site project offices that move with the work.

If your site sits anywhere along the Avinashi Road or NH-948 corridor, a single truck delivers and places the cabin in a day.

Specifications and sizes

Every SAMAN porta cabin is built on a welded MS steel frame using IS 2062 grade hollow sections. The standard build:

  • Frame: mild steel hollow section, welded and anti-rust treated
  • Wall panels: PUF insulated sandwich panel or cement fibre board, depending on use
  • Roof: GI sheet or colour-coated profile sheet with slope for rain runoff
  • Flooring: marine ply, cement board, or vinyl over a steel base
  • Doors and windows: powder-coated steel or aluminium, positioned to your layout

Common sizes run from a compact 6Ã—8 ft security cabin up to larger 20Ã—8 ft and 40Ã—8 ft office units, with multi-room layouts available. For the full construction detail and finish options, see the MS porta cabin product page â€” that is the build most Coimbatore site offices use. Any size in between is made to order; we do not limit you to fixed models.

Customisation options

Tell us how the cabin will be used and we build around it. Common additions:

  • Split AC points and extra power sockets for office use
  • Internal partitions for a separate cabin or meeting area
  • Toilet and washbasin block built into the unit
  • Extra windows or a glass front for a reception or sales cabin
  • Loft storage above the ceiling line
  • Anti-skid flooring for wet or workshop areas

Price guidance

A porta cabin price in Coimbatore depends on four things: the size, the wall panel you choose (cement board is economical, PUF panel costs more but insulates better), the level of interior fit-out, and the transport distance to your exact site. Because every unit is made to order, we give a firm price only after we understand your requirement. Share your size and use, and we confirm the figure at quotation â€” no hidden add-ons after.

Delivery and installation to Coimbatore

Your cabin is built and finished at our Bangalore factory, then trucked to Coimbatore â€” typically 3 to 5 days from dispatch. Smaller units arrive fully assembled and are craned into position in a few hours. Larger or multi-room units arrive in sections and are bolted together on site by our team. You need a level base â€” a plinth, a concrete pad, or compacted ground â€” ready before delivery.

We deliver across South India on the same model. If you are comparing options for a nearby site, you can also look at our porta cabin in Chennai and porta cabin in Hyderabad pages, both served from the same Bangalore factory.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a porta cabin cost in Coimbatore?

The price depends on size, panel type, and fit-out. A small security cabin costs far less than a fully fitted office unit. We confirm the exact figure at quotation once we know your size and use.

How long does delivery to Coimbatore take?

Usually 3 to 5 days from dispatch out of our Bangalore factory, since the road distance is about 365 km.

Can the porta cabin be moved later?

Yes. A porta cabin is a bolted steel structure. It can be lifted, loaded, and relocated to another site when your work moves.

Do you install the cabin on site in Coimbatore?

Smaller units arrive ready and are placed directly. Larger multi-room units are assembled on site by our team. You only need a level base ready before delivery.

What sizes are available?

From a 6Ã—8 ft single cabin up to 40Ã—8 ft office units and larger multi-room layouts. Every size is made to order, so you are not limited to fixed models.

Get a quote for your porta cabin in Coimbatore

Tell us your size, use, and site location and we will send a clear quote. For Bangalore and South India, call +91 88616 22859 or +91 80886 85440, or send an enquiry through the form and our team will get back to you.
